data.raw:
## [Q3LOCK KKK Duhamel normalization and scalar Fourier source pin recorded] - 2026-09-05

Added the T0 source-pin note and EXP-001513. KKK Eq. (3.1) and Eq. (3.8) are recorded as the integrated-loop covariance convention; after unit-direction projection, D_KKK^u=beta^2 D_L and the full-vector nu factor is not copied into the scalar Q3LOCK estimate. KKK Corollary 3.14 remains excluded because Q3 is nonradial. The source pin resolves the beta, component-count and 2E(p) bookkeeping only; P-04/P-06/P-09/P-12 remain open and PDF generation remains deferred until content freeze and independent review.

## [Q3LOCK EXP-000782 clean deterministic reproduction recorded] - 2026-09-05

Added the T0 clean-reproduction audit and EXP-001515. After installing the requirements-complete SymPy/mpmath dependencies, the current primary, independent and integrated lanes pass 195/195, 306/306 and 120/120; two reruns per lane produce identical SHA-256 artifacts. The executable package is now deterministic, but P-06/P-09 proof audits, claim registration and content freeze remain open, and PDF generation is still deferred.
